targets.old_statement: Keep to the right half of the roadway; opposite-direction vehicles pass each other on the right, a narrow road requires leaving oncoming vehicles at least half of its main traveled portion, and a driver moving slower than other traffic belongs in the extreme right lane.
targets.statement: Drive on the right half of the roadway, pass oncoming vehicles on the right, give opposite-direction traffic at least half of the main traveled roadway on narrow roads, and when moving slower than other traffic you should use the extreme right lane.

correction.corrected_statement: You must drive on the right half of the roadway where opposite direction vehicles pass on the right and narrow roads leave oncoming vehicles at least half of the main traveled portion, and when moving slower than other traffic you should drive in the extreme right lane.
correction.note: Changed must to should for slower traffic in extreme right lane.

targets.old_statement: You may pass on the right of a vehicle that is about to turn left, but never by leaving the pavement or main traveled portion, and you may also pass on the right on a paved road with two or more marked lanes in your direction or on a one-way street with two or more marked lanes.
targets.statement: Passing on the right is permitted when the vehicle ahead is about to turn left without driving off the pavement or main traveled roadway, on a paved road with two or more marked lanes in each direction, or on a one-way street with two or more marked lanes.

correction.corrected_statement: You may pass on the right of a vehicle about to make a left turn without driving off the pavement or main traveled portion of the roadway, and you may also pass on the right on a paved street or highway with two or more lanes marked for traffic in each direction or on a one way street with two or more lanes marked for traffic.
correction.note: Changed your direction to in each direction for multilane passing on right.

targets.old_statement: Funeral processions and convoys have the right of way at intersections, their vehicles usually show headlamps and the first and last vehicles carry distinctive markings, and you must not drive between the vehicles of a funeral procession.
targets.statement: Funeral processions and convoys have the right of way at intersections, their vehicles usually use headlamps for identification while the first and last vehicles usually carry distinctive markings, and you should not drive between vehicles in a funeral procession.

correction.corrected_statement: Funeral processions and convoys have the right of way at intersections with vehicles usually using headlamps for identification and the first and last vehicles usually having a distinctive marking, and you should not drive your vehicle between the vehicles in a funeral procession.
correction.note: Changed must not to should not for driving between procession vehicles.
